subject.title: fix(agents): allow empty-error-retry when replayMetadata is absent (#97877)

question: Should PR #97966 be the canonical fix for #97877 despite the retry-order and optional attempt-result contract change?
rationale: There are multiple open candidate PRs for the same issue, and this one changes agent retry behavior where mistakes could duplicate side effects or drop channel replies; that merge-risk choice needs maintainer ownership even though I found no blocking patch defect.

options.title: Accept #97966 as canonical
options.body: Merge this branch after normal base refresh and CI review, accepting the optional current-attempt metadata contract and `server_error` retry semantics.

options.title: Request stronger classified-500 proof
options.body: Ask the contributor for live or proxy proof where a JSON provider HTTP 500 classifies as `server_error` and then recovers through the retry path.

options.title: Choose another candidate PR
options.body: Keep this open only until maintainers select a different open PR as the canonical implementation, then close duplicate candidates after the chosen fix lands.
